subject: Initialize the lua attributes of the luaFunction script (#2750)
reason: The change fixes an uninitialized-field bug: in the two FUNCTION-registration paths the luaFunction script was zmalloc'd, so script->lua held garbage, and luaEngineFreeFunction's `if (lua == script->lua) lua_unref(...)` guard then skipped releasing the Lua registry reference when an individual library was freed (FUNCTION DELETE, or a REPLACE load over an existing library) while the function VM persisted. The only effect is a Lua-registry reference leak: the orphaned function object stays reachable from the VM's LUA_REGISTRYINDEX table and is reclaimed only at VM teardown. This produces no dete
